title: Reykjavík City cyberattack, Nov 2026

subject.name: Reykjavík City
subject.about: Reykjavík City is the local government of Reykjavík, the capital of Iceland. It is governed by a City Council of 23 elected councillors, and the Mayor, appointed by the council, runs the city's administration.

disclaimer: Made for entertainment using AI. Not endorsed by Reykjavík City, any news outlet, company, or anyone else named.
size_basis: One city government, Iceland's capital, and the people who use its online services. The city has not said how many people's data, if any, was reached.
who_is_affected: People who use Reykjavík City's online services. Online applications for financial assistance are unavailable; the city asks people to apply at one of its offices. The city has not yet said whether anyone's personal data was taken.

known.text: Reykjavík City says it suffered a cyberattack on several of its computer systems on Nov 25 and took many online services offline.
The city is still working out how the attackers got in and what data they may have accessed.
Its website still says online services are disrupted, and online applications for financial assistance are unavailable.
The city is working with the security firm Syndis and CERT-IS, and is resetting all passwords and access keys.

not_known.text: Whether personal data was taken, and whose.
Who was behind the attack and whether it was ransomware.
Whether it is linked to the attack on the Blue Lagoon the same day.
